I am a Mathematics graduate with practical Business Intelligence
experience at PKF Attest. I work mainly with Power BI and SQL,
with Python and R for analysis. I also hold a separate bachelor's
degree in Primary Education.

I am looking for a junior Data Analyst or BI Analyst role in an
international, English-speaking team, particularly in Switzerland.
I am based in Madrid, available immediately and willing to relocate.

[Explore my projects](#selected-projects) ·
[Get in touch](mailto:lauraiglesiasgarcia23@outlook.es)

## Business Intelligence experience

### PKF Attest · Madrid

**Business Intelligence Intern · 676 hours**

As the only intern in an eight-person BI team, I worked across
three live client accounts, contributing to data preparation,
modelling, reporting and visualisation.

- Developed Power BI dashboards and DAX calculations for client reporting.
- Prepared and transformed data with Power Query and worked with
  SQL Server stored procedures and data models.
- Investigated a reconciliation issue involving two source systems,
  identified duplicate records, corrected them and added checks
  to prevent recurrence.
- Independently designed a client tracking report, from discussing
  requirements to building billing and customer quality reporting pages.
- Presented dashboards to clients and trained business users.

The work I find most rewarding is making reporting trustworthy:
understanding where a number comes from, checking how it is
calculated and explaining what it can support.

## Selected projects

### Gamification & Commercial Success in Educational Math Apps

**Mathematics bachelor's thesis · R · Statistical analysis**

Investigated how gamification features relate to downloads of
educational mathematics apps, using a sample of 200 Google Play
apps and exploratory OLS analysis.

The project examines model assumptions and robustness, while
distinguishing commercial popularity from educational quality.

[Read the case study](gamification.qmd) ·
[Explore the code](https://github.com/lauraiglesiasgr/gamification-math-apps-analysis) ·
[Read the thesis](https://github.com/lauraiglesiasgr/gamification-math-apps-analysis/blob/main/report/TFG_Iglesias_Garcia.pdf)

### Climate Trends in Spain and Europe

**PKF Attest project · Data analysis · Published company report**

Carried out the end-to-end analysis of temperature and precipitation
trends across Spain and Europe for a report later published by
PKF Attest. The work covered source data through to short and
long report formats for clients.

[Official publication (English)](https://www.pkf-attest.es/tecnologia/en/novedades-itc/informe-clima-2025-datos-power-bi/) ·
[Read the report (PDF, Spanish)](https://www.pkf-attest.es/tecnologia/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/09/Informe-Clima-2025-min.pdf)

### Mathematical Flexibility in Primary Education

**Primary Education bachelor's thesis · Mixed methods · JASP**

Designed and evaluated a five-session classroom study combining
written assessments, structured observation and qualitative records.
The study followed 15 participants selected through stratified
sampling within a class of 22.

The case study examines analytical choices, aggregate findings and
the limits of different assessment formats. 

[Explore the case study](mathematical-flexibility/index.qmd) ·
[Inspect the results](mathematical-flexibility/evidence.qmd)
